title.en: List operations and traversing a list

heading.en: Joining, slicing and walking through lists

hook.en: Two sections merge for a lab session. Joining their attendance lists, picking the first ten students, checking if a roll number is present — all are list operations.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಾಜರಿ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಜೋಡಿಸುವುದು, ಮೊದಲ ಹತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುವುದು, ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಇದೆಯೇ ನೋಡುವುದು — ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಗಳು.

objectives.en: Traverse lists with for and while

narration.en: Two sections merge for a lab session. Joining their attendance lists, picking the first ten students, checking if a roll number is present — all are list operations.

body.en: Concatenation (+) joins two lists into a new list; both operands must be lists. Repetition (*) repeats the elements. in and not in test whether an element is present. Slicing L[n:m:k] works as for strings and returns a new list; assigning to a slice can replace several elements at once.
body.kn: + ಎರಡು ಲಿಸ್ಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಹೊಸ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. * ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. in ಮತ್ತು not in ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ಲೈಸಿಂಗ್ ಹೊಸ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Concatenation (+) joins two lists into a new list; both operands must be lists. Repetition (*) repeats the elements. in and not in test whether an element is present. Slicing L[n:m:k] works as for strings and returns a new list; assigning to a slice can replace several elements at once.
narration.kn: + ಎರಡು ಲಿಸ್ಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಹೊಸ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. * ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. in ಮತ್ತು not in ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ಲೈಸಿಂಗ್ ಹೊಸ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Joining, repeating and slicing lists

say.en: Plus joins two lists into a new list. Star repeats the elements.
Slicing L from 1 to 4 takes indexes 1, 2 and 3. The stop index is never included.
A negative step walks backwards. L from minus 2 to 0 with step minus 2 gives 25 and 15.
L with two colons and step minus 1 reverses the list.
To visit every element we can loop over the list, or over its indexes with range of len of L.

narration.en: We join and repeat lists, then slice a list from both ends.

body.en: We can visit each element with for item in L, or use the index with for i in range(len(L)) or a while loop with i < len(L). The index form is needed when we want to change elements in place.
body.kn: for item in L ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶವನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ range(len(L)) ಅಥವಾ while ಲೂಪ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಇಂಡೆಕ್ಸ್ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಲು ಇಂಡೆಕ್ಸ್ ರೂಪ ಬೇಕು.

points.en: for i in range(len(L)): L[i] = L[i] * 2 doubles every element

title.en: How many elements does a slice take?

caption.en: For a list of 10 elements, change start, stop and step of L[start:stop:step] and read how many elements the slice has.

tryThis.en: start 1, stop 4, step 1: which indexes are taken?
Make stop smaller than start: why is the slice empty?
start 0, stop 10, step 3: list the indexes.

narration.en: For a list of 10 elements, change start, stop and step of L[start:stop:step] and read how many elements the slice has. start 1, stop 4, step 1: which indexes are taken?

problem.en: Merge two sections, take the first three roll numbers and check membership.

steps.en: secA + secB gives a NEW list; secA and secB are unchanged.

narration.en: Let us trace this code together. Merge two sections, take the first three roll numbers and check membership. Predict the output before we run it.

problem.en: Double every element of a list in place using its index.

steps.en: i takes 0, 1, 2; each L[i] is replaced by twice its value.

narration.en: Let us trace this code together. Double every element of a list in place using its index. Predict the output before we run it.

heading.en: Slice assignment can grow or shrink a list

body.en: L[a:b] = new_list replaces the slice by however many elements new_list has, so the length may change.

narration.en: Slice assignment can grow or shrink a list. L[a:b] = new_list replaces the slice by however many elements new_list has, so the length may change.

points.en: + concatenates and * repeats lists; in tests membership of whole elements.
points.kn: + ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, * ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; in ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂಶದ ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Slicing gives a new list; slice assignment replaces part of a list.

points.en: Use for item in L to read, and for i in range(len(L)) to change elements.

homework.en: Write a program that prints only the even numbers from a list of 10 numbers.

narration.en: Recap. + concatenates and * repeats lists; in tests membership of whole elements. Slicing gives a new list; slice assignment replaces part of a list. Use for item in L to read, and for i in range(len(L)) to change elements.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. + ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, * ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; in ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂಶದ ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ಲೈಸಿಂಗ್ ಹೊಸ ಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಸ್ಲೈಸ್‌ಗೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಕೊಟ್ಟರೆ ಭಾಗ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಓದಲು for item in L, ಬದಲಿಸಲು for i in range(len(L)).
